name: LYING KNEE HUG
introduce: Lie on your back with your legs slightly lifted. \n\nLift one knee up and pull it towards your chest as far as you can, while fully extending the other leg simultaneously, but don’t touch the ground. Then switch sides, and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Always keep your lower back on the floor.
Please keep your other leg fully extended.
Please don\'t touch the ground when you extend your leg.
